title: Privacy

control.discoverableHelp: Off hides your profiles from Businesses & Professionals; direct links still work.
control.capabilityVisibleHelp: Anyone can see the skills or services you offer.
control.seekingVisibleHelp: Off by default. When on, others can see you're open to work or customers.
control.contactDisclosureHelp: Choose when your phone or other contact channels are shown to others.
control.notificationsEnabledHelp: In-app alerts for strong matches and updates on things you're part of.
control.commercialCommsHelp: Off by default. When on, we may tell you about promotions, plans and offers.
control.behavioralAnalyticsHelp: Lets Vyapar record how you use the app, without your name, to improve it. Nothing is recorded while this is off.
control.digestEnabledHelp: One message a day about new posts that match you.

dataRights.title: Your data
dataRights.deleteWarning: This anonymizes your profile everywhere on Vyapar. Your own profiles, requests and reviews are kept but no longer show your name.
dataRights.exportReady: Your data is ready — tap to view
dataRights.blocked: Deletion is on hold until an active paid order finishes.
dataRights.exportHint: A copy of everything Vyapar holds about you.
dataRights.deleteHint: Your name is removed everywhere; your posts and requests stay without it.

preferences.title: Learned preferences
preferences.help: Vyapar noticed these from how you use it. Confirm the ones that are right.

delete.blocked: Your account can't be deleted yet: finish or close your open requests and contracts first.
delete.done: Your account is scheduled for deletion. We'll confirm when it is done.
